# State Management Checklist: SPEC-013B - Claim and Reconciliation Authority

**Purpose**: Validate that claim lifecycle, reconciliation deferral, terminal release, and long-running ownership boundaries are specified as measurable state-management requirements.
**Created**: 2026-05-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Claim Lifecycle State

- [x] CHK001 Are active claim states defined as a closed serializable enum with row-terminal semantics? [Clarity, Data Model §Task Stage Claim]
- [x] CHK002 Are legal state transitions for `active`, `released`, and `stale_recovered` defined without ambiguous intermediate states? [Consistency, Data Model §Task Stage Claim]
- [x] CHK003 Are stale-recovery ordering requirements specified so the predecessor claim leaves `active` before replacement acquisition? [Completeness, Plan §Implementation Notes > Migration M78]
- [x] CHK004 Are late stale-owner mutation requirements defined for releases that race with replacement claims? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]

## Lease Expiry And Ownership

- [x] CHK005 Are lease start, expiry, owner, and run identifiers specified with serializable fields and objective time units? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications; Data Model §Task Stage Claim]
- [x] CHK006 Is the launch-critical-section TTL bounded with default and maximum values that prevent long-running execution ownership? [Measurability, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements clear that SPEC-013B ownership ends at scheduler reconciliation and launch handoff rather than SPEC-014 harness execution? [Scope, Spec §FR-016]

## Release Reasons And Terminal States

- [x] CHK008 Is `release_reason` defined as a closed vocabulary for normal handoff, terminal reconciliation, governance release, dispatch failure, task terminal release, and stale recovery? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications; Data Model §Task Stage Claim; Plan §Implementation Notes > Migration M78]
- [x] CHK009 Are terminal Mission Control task states enumerated for active-claim release decisions instead of referenced generically? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008; Data Model §Task Stage Claim; Plan §Local Terminal Task Statuses]
- [x] CHK010 Are linked GitHub issue and PR terminal states defined consistently between prevention and active-claim release requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 Are release evidence fields sufficient to serialize who released the claim, when it was released, why it was released, and which run performed the release? [Completeness, Data Model §Reconciliation Decision]

## Deferrals And Durable Evidence

- [x] CHK012 Are stale-truth, governance, terminal, duplicate, and not-claimable deferrals represented as durable outcomes rather than silent skips? [Completeness, Data Model §Reconciliation Decision]
- [x] CHK013 Are deferral outcomes tied to closed activity types and reason codes that can be reconstructed after scheduler restarts? [Traceability, API Contract §Read Model States And Reasons]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements explicit that governance block/defer records evidence without acquiring an active claim? [Consistency, Research §Decision: Evaluate governance before active claim insert]

## Read Model And Side Effects

- [x] CHK015 Is the read-only `task_claim_reconciliation.v1` state model defined with closed eligibility states and side-effect-free behavior? [Clarity, API Contract §Read Model States And Reasons]
- [x] CHK016 Are flag-off state-management requirements specified so legacy dispatch remains authoritative and claim history stays read-only? [Consistency, API Contract §Flag-Off Response]

## Boundary Preservation

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements explicit that claim/release/recovery/deferral paths do not advance task chains or create successor tasks? [Scope, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements explicit that active claim persistence must not use passive task-stage attempt status as the lock? [Scope, Spec §Project Constraints]

## Notes

- CHK008 closed by adding the persisted `release_reason` vocabulary to the spec clarifications, data model, migration plan, and module contract.
- CHK009 closed by enumerating `done` and `failed` as the only local terminal Mission Control statuses for claim release and by excluding `awaiting_owner` and `ready_for_owner` as terminal release states.
- Re-run 2026-05-27: State-management checklist re-evaluated after remediation; no new requirement-writing gaps were found.
